# Georgetown Law Technology Review

> A scholarly publication examining the intersection of technology law, policy, and regulation with focus on platform governance, AI oversight, and digital rights.

Georgetown Law Technology Review publishes research and analysis on emerging technology law issues, including platform regulation, AI governance, accessibility standards, and federal policy frameworks. The publication features work from Georgetown Law faculty and researchers addressing critical questions at the intersection of technology and law.

## Key Topics

- Section 230 Reform
- AI Governance
- Platform Accessibility
- Sports Betting Regulation
- Federal Preemption
- Information Asymmetry
- Tech Law Policy
- Americans with Disabilities Act
- One Big Beautiful Act (OBBA)
- Digital Rights
- Platform Regulation
- Accessibility Standards

## Core Pages

- [Georgetown Law Technology Review](https://georgetownlawtechreview.org): Homepage for Georgetown Law Technology Review covering tech law policy topics
